sources.title: Rajiv Bajaj: family and career biography
sources.findings: Birth December 21, 1966; Pune mechanical engineering 1988; manufacturing/supply chain 1990–95, R&D 1995–2000, marketing/sales 2000–05; MD April 2005.
sources.caution: Warwick master year 1990 conflicts with company filing and interview 1991. Omit master graduation year. Homeopathy-based strategy claims not endorsed as scientific evidence.

sources.title: 18 March 2020 filing: Annexure A biography
sources.findings: Legal name Rajivnayan Rahulkumar Bajaj, birth December 21, 1966; Pune mechanical engineering and Warwick manufacturing systems engineering master; MD since April 2005.
sources.caution: Read Rajiv appointment and Annexure A only. Master year 1991 differs from group biography; 2020 reappointment is historical, not current term.

sources.title: 1 September 2010: emerging-market strategy interview
sources.findings: Biography confirms birth, 1990 career start and 2005 MD; discussion of motorcycle focus, brand positioning and common production platforms.
sources.caution: Historical market rankings and partner relationships not asserted current. Strategy is the executive’s account, not independent proof of every claimed benefit.

sources.title: 31 January 2012: A decade of Pulsar proves Bajaj’s point
sources.findings: Pulsar introduced in 2001 before Rajiv became MD in 2005; central to motorcycle/brand strategy.
sources.caution: Do not copy another retrospective’s claim he was already MD in 2001; product and team contributions not sole personal invention.

sources.title: 14 January 2020: Chetak electric scooter launch
sources.findings: Commercial launch of electric Chetak, bookings opening the next day.
sources.caution: 2020 launch distinct from earlier unveiling and historical petrol Chetak; no launch date equated with first delivery or national availability.

sources.title: 5 July 2024: Freedom 125 launch
sources.findings: Motorcycle can switch between CNG and petrol; product launch confirmed.
sources.caution: Fuel efficiency, range and export ambitions are claims/plans, not independently verified outcomes. Not electric or zero-emission.

sources.title: 2025–26 directors report: reappointment
sources.findings: Shareholders approved April 30, 2025; five-year MD/CEO term April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2030. Group centenary distinct from Auto origins in 1945 and 2008 demerger.
sources.caution: Read relevant appointment and history sections only. 2030 is scheduled term end, not completed service. Rakesh Sharma joint MD does not replace Rajiv.

sources.title: 2025–26 consolidated audit report: KTM acquisition
sources.findings: November 18, 2025 BAIH BV acquired remaining 50.1% of former Pierer Bajaj AG, making it wholly owned; effective 74.9% in Bajaj Mobility and KTM group.
sources.caution: Read acquisition key-audit-matter paragraphs only, not full financials. Corporate indirect control, not Rajiv personal purchase, 100% KTM ownership or proven turnaround.

sources.title: 11 May 2026: Bajaj Group centenary event
sources.findings: Mumbai event report quotes Rajiv on consistency between words and actions and trust.
sources.caution: Bajaj Group centenary is not Bajaj Auto’s centenary. Niraj is Auto chairman; Nirav leads new healthcare business, not Rajiv.

sources.title: September 2026 directorship details
sources.findings: Rajiv MD and CEO/executive director of Auto; Niraj nonexecutive chairman; Rakesh joint MD.
sources.caution: Read relevant table entries, not independent verification of all outside appointments. Do not confuse Sanjiv’s finance/Finserv chairmanship with Rajiv.
